missing_information_behavior: Do not recommend an electrolyte formula until kidney/heart diagnosis, medication list and exact sodium/potassium content are known; refer for clinician review.
safety_exclusions: Do not assume all electrolyte products have similar composition.
Do not recommend potassium-containing products without renal and medication review.
Do not advise fluid or sodium restriction changes contrary to prescribed care.
professional_escalation_conditions: Chronic kidney disease, heart failure, edema, hypertension, hyperkalemia, diuretic use or fluid restriction.
population_and_context: People with kidney or heart disease considering electrolyte products; sodium and potassium content can materially affect fluid balance, blood pressure and serum electrolyte status.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule. Review sodium and potassium per serving, total daily intake, renal function and clinician-directed fluid/electrolyte plan.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Potassium fact sheet supports potassium safety context; sodium/fluid decisions in kidney and heart disease require condition-specific clinical guidance.
